CheckTitle: No Integrated Windows Authentication agent pools exist
Description: Checks that no IWA agent pools exist.
Risk: IWA agent pools represent legacy desktop SSO architecture that Okta recommends migrating away from.

Code.Other:
1. Inventory existing IWA agents and routing rules.
2. Configure and test agentless Desktop Single Sign-on.
3. Set IWA only as a temporary failover option if required during migration.
4. Disable On-Prem Desktop SSO/IWA after agentless Desktop SSO is active.
5. Delete remaining IWA agents and routing rules after validation.

Recommendation.Text: Migrate away from Integrated Windows Authentication agents and use agentless Desktop Single Sign-on where desktop SSO is still required.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
